description:
Approval of details pursuant to condition 4 of planning permission ref. P2025/2307/LBC dated 13/01/2026
BATHROOM (DETAILS): Notwithstanding the drawings hereby approved, details showing the routing of plumbing and measures to mitigate damage to the floor joists, and a suitable ventilation strategy to the approved bathroom, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of this part of the work. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained as such thereafter into perpetuity. REASON: In order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the heritage asset.
